trophies.guide: Finish the mission Gone Fishing. It is the first story trophy and pops as you play through Chapter 1, so there is nothing extra to plan for it.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 in all, shown as purple icons when you are close. Each outdoor spot counts twice if you meditate there with both characters, so bring your partner every time. The one you can miss is the balcony of Jason's house in Chapter 1: after Lucia is home, check the kitchen in the morning, follow her out to the balcony and accept the optional task. It is gone once Chapter 1 ends, and there is no mission replay, so keep a manual save from Chapter 1 until this trophy pops.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. Chapter trophies can pop at the start of the next chapter rather than on the last cutscene, so do not worry if it arrives a beat late. Before you leave Chapter 1, make sure the balcony meditation for Positive Mental Attitude is done.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Once both characters are playable you can switch between them and call the other in as your partner, which opens up the partner trophies.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. The robbery tools arrive through missions in the middle of the game, so the heist trophies start opening up around here.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. Bank vault jobs open through an optional mission near the end of this chapter, so do not cross into the finale without a save set aside.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Finish the final mission. Keep an untouched manual save from just before it: there is no mission replay, and that save is your safety net if you want to mop up anything afterwards.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Finish the mission Breakfast Run. It pops as you play the story, with no extra step.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Finish the mission The Cartel Heist. It pops as you play the story, with no extra step.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Finish the mission Child's Play. It pops as you play the story, with no extra step.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Finish the mission Headliners. It pops as you play the story, with no extra step.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Finish the mission VCIA Takedown. It pops as you play the story, with no extra step.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Finish the mission Operation Savage Glory. It pops as you play the story, with no extra step.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: This one pops on its own once the other 54 trophies are done, so there is nothing extra to do for it. Work through the roadmap and it arrives last.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion, tracked under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion once the story is done. The checklist counts stunts, vaults, challenges and the rest listed in the 100% section below, so keep chipping at those counters after the credits rather than treating this as a separate hunt.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts: stunt jumps, flights under bridges, knife flights and base jumps all count. Start early and grab them as you travel, since 100% completion wants 300, so the trophy is only a milestone on the way to the full count.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge. There are 42 gold medals across the two ranges, so practise each range until every challenge shows gold.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Only some optional questlines count, and Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's strands have their own trophies, so they do not count here. Check the trophy's progress counter after each strand you finish.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK It activity at 100 locations. It is a slow burn, so do it whenever you pass a spot rather than saving all 100 for the end.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once. There are 9 types, so sample everything the map offers early: a race, a round of fishing, an arcade game and the rest, one of each.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Each race only counts once, so work through different events instead of replaying one you like.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. The map starts under fog and the trophy counts once none is left. A plane clears the fog fastest, and one can be found early in Chapter 1.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every location. There are 14 locations, and you need at least one win at each.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal, take him on at fishing and win the challenge.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Pick any arcade machine and play it through to the end.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are listed under Progress, then Challenges, and many complete on their own while you play. The 100% checklist wants 70 of the 80, so keep going past 50.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida and come in sets, so keep collecting and check your sets as you go; you need 3 finished sets out of 18 in total.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and get clear. Vault jobs open through the optional mission That's Where The Money Is near the end of Chapter 4: tail an armored van to a large bank and slip into the vault while the guard has it open. Bring your partner, since you cannot carry all the bags alone, and expect a 4-star Wanted Level on the way out. The 100% checklist wants all 8 vaults.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Bank vault jobs hand you 4 stars straight away, so escaping one with your partner earns this at the same time. It only pops once you are out of the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back to back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Call your partner, then hit the green robbery icons one after another and keep the flashing police Wanted Level up the whole time; if the stars fade and only the red heat zone is left, the chain breaks. It can take about 30 seconds to pop after you leave the third shop.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is the slow-motion aim, L3 and R3 while aiming. Pick a group of gang enemies, such as the guards at an illegal operation, and use an assault rifle; Adrenaline extends Focus.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. The Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs gives you the Snap Gun and opens jewelry store robberies: use it on a store's locked back door, since kicking the door in sets off the alarm. Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, open the safe and leave without being seen. Richardson Jewelry and Diamonds in Vice City is a good target; if someone spots you, reload rather than push on.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Watch for armored trucks on the road, hit one and get clear of the heat; like the vault jobs, it only pops once you are out of the red heat zone.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. The 100% checklist wants all 39 operations, so this pops along the way if you keep robbing them.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scanning a vehicle with the WAiNK app counts as discovering it, so scan traffic as you drive. The 100% checklist wants 200 of the 277 base models, so keep scanning past 100.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from bank and payday loan jobs, and you sell them on to your contacts; the total is cumulative.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. The total is cumulative across every kind of shop, so normal shopping on the way through the game feeds it.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Buy the 8 garages in the Vice City Real Estate app, which unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver; together they cost about $160,000. Garages the story gives you do not count.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The Chapter 2 mission Moses opens the app: take a stolen car to Moses, choose Respray, then Register. From Chapter 3 you can also register cars with a standard tracker at Pay 'n' Spray. Each car needs a free garage space, so buy garages first and register cheap cars.
trophies.name: On the Spot

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's last mission. Side-story finales stay open after the credits, so there is no rush and nothing to miss.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's last mission. Side-story finales stay open after the credits, so there is no rush and nothing to miss.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's last mission. Side-story finales stay open after the credits, so there is no rush and nothing to miss.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's last mission. Side-story finales stay open after the credits, so there is no rush and nothing to miss.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's last mission. Side-story finales stay open after the credits, so there is no rush and nothing to miss.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret Vogel's hunting questline is Jason-only and sends you after animals through target decks; a clean head or heart shot keeps the carcass pristine.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked at a boarding bridge at Vice City International Airport; planes parked elsewhere on the airfield do not count, and the gates E3 and E4 work. Go up to the cockpit, back out toward the runway and take off. The trophy is delayed: fly about 1 km away from the airport and it pops. Save first, because the police come fast.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Get into a military tank. Tanks should be parked on the south side of Mile Zero Air Station, on the island at the far southwest of the map. Save first, get in, and drive and fire until it pops.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: The Kolt and Associates bowling alley is Kingpin Bowling, an illegal operation you visit in Chapter 2. Bring Sticky Bombs and take all three key valuables: the luxury watch in an office, the shotgun on a table, and the contents of the office safe, which you blow open with a Sticky Bomb. Then escape the police. If you leave something behind, the operation comes back later, so it is not missable.
trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling

trophies.guide: This one should pop when Jason and Lucia both reach maximum Strength. Buy a gym membership and train with your partner there, since the partner trains alongside you.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Make choices that change your Criminal Profile: 500 of them, by GamesRadar+'s count as reported by gtasix.how. Robberies and fights feed it, so it fills up without a separate grind.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Find a bar spot on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and enjoy the view.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Crash out of a car showroom through the window. Drive a car into a showroom and smash your way back out through the glass.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.guide: No guide has spelled out how this one pops yet. The official description is a riddle, 'Second time's the charm,' and neither of the guides this entry draws on gives a verified method, so this guide will not invent one. Treat any video claiming a trick with suspicion until a method is confirmed.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Find the UFO random encounter in Kelly County after 2am: a car with flickering lights waits at the roadside and the UFO shows up further up the road. Talk to the stranger, then go back to her car.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock people over with a melee attack from a moving vehicle.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
